title: se-implementation-scratchpad-elm-park-bank
content:
Quick scratchpad from SE onboarding / config work for Elm Park Bank (EPB). Mostly a running todo + config notes for Private deployment (customer wants VPC + HSM/KMS integration). Meeting notes (2024-11-07 call with EPB infra + security):

- Attendees: David H. (EPB infra), Rachel T. (EPB security), Samira (Redwood SE), Liam (Redwood infra), Priya (Redwood PM)
- Goals: get Private deployment plan aligned, confirm network requirements, KMS/HSM integration approach, rollout timeline and canary plan. EPB legal pushes for audit logs retention 7 years (we flagged retention + storage cost).

Key constraints / requirements from EPB:
- VPC peering (or private link) required, traffic must not traverse public internet for inference traffic.
- Bring-your-own-KMS preferred (AWS KMS with customer key), HSM if needed for keys-at-rest.
- IP allowlist for admin console, SSO via SAML (Okta).
- Data residency: primary in us-east-1, DR in eu-west-1 (they have regs for EU customers).
- SLA target for model endpoints: 99.9% uptime, p95 latency budget 200ms for short-chat endpoints; batch/async allowed to be higher.
- Audit/logging: push to their Splunk via HTTPS; request for log of prompt inputs (redaction policy TBD) + per-request trace ids.

Current TODOs (owner / ETA):
- [ ] Finalize network diagram (VPC subnets, peering, route tables, NATs, SGs) -- owner: Liam -- ETA: 2024-11-12
- [ ] KMS integration doc + IAM policy template for EPB account -- owner: Priya -- ETA: 2024-11-14
- [ ] SAML SSO config steps + test account (Okta metadata) -- owner: Samira -- ETA: 2024-11-13
- [ ] Canary rollout plan + rollback criteria (qps ramp, perf checks, error budget) -- owner: Samira/Liam -- ETA: 2024-11-15
- [ ] Cost estimate for 3-month dedicated capacity (NVIDIA A10x or equivalent) + storage/egress -- owner: Marco -- ETA: 2024-11-13
- [ ] Legal: confirm allowed logging of customer prompts (PII policy) -- owner: David H. (customer) / Samira to follow up -- ETA: 2024-11-18

Technical notes / config checklist (working):
- Deployment mode: Redwood Private (VPC peering + private control plane).
- Regions: primary us-east-1 (production), secondary eu-west-1 (DR).
- Network: recommend 3 AZs per region. Subnet plan: public subnets for bastion + NAT; private subnets for nodes (min 3 private subnets across AZs).
- Ports: allow outbound to Redwood control plane endpoints on 443 (if using managed control plane). If customer opts for fully private control plane, we need spoke/hosted control plane discussion.
- KMS: customer will create CMK in their account and grant Redwood SE IAM principal (or cross-account role) encrypt/decrypt permissions. Need KMS key policy PR template. If HSM requested, escalate to security (Marco).
- IAM/service account: create cross-account role Arn: arn:aws:iam::[EPB_ACCOUNT]:role/RedwoodPrivateAccess (we will provide assume-role policy).
- DNS: customer will create private hosted zone and route 3 endpoints: console.epb.internal, api.epb.internal, metrics.epb.internal -> point to internal NLBs.
- Certs: they want certs via ACM Private CA; need to share CSR/validation steps.
- Data plane encryption: at rest via KMS; in transit TLS1.2+ enforced.
- Logging: Fluentd sidecar to forward logs to customer Splunk HEC. Need HEC token + endpoint (TLS).
- Tracing: enable distributed tracing headers (x-redwood-trace). EPB wants correlation id surfaced in logs.

Model / runtime notes:
- Models requested: openchat-medium (customer benchmark) + larger LLM for longer contexts. We'll recommend 8-bit quantization for cost, but run a quality eval before canary.
- Throughput target: baseline 150 req/s low-latency chat, spikes to 400 for batch windows. Configure autoscaling with burst capacity.
- KV/prefix caching: we should enable 30s prefix cache for session reuse to save tokens on short session flows. Documenting cache TTLs for their ops team.

Canary / rollout plan (rough):
- Phase 0: dry-run in staging (use subset of real traffic, shadow mode) -- verify latency, logs, metrics integration.
- Phase 1: 5% traffic to Redwood Private endpoints, monitor p95, error rate, token cost. 24h window.
- Phase 2: 25% traffic for 48h, run model QA sampling (prompt/responses) and human QA.
- Phase 3: 100% after sign-off and legal clearance.
- Rollback: route traffic back to hosted API or previous model; automated alert at 2x baseline error rate or sustained p95 > 2x budget for 30m.

Open questions / risks (flagged):
- Prompt logging: if we cannot log full prompts due to PII, how will we do quality monitoring? Suggest hashed prompts + small sample of reviewed prompts with redaction.
- KMS cross-account permission approach: prefer cross-account role over key policy (security prefers role), confirm with EPB security.
- DR failover time target? EPB hasn't committed. Need RTO/RPO acceptance.
- Network egress costs: estimate needed for budgeting (Marco to calculate).

Notes/to-self:
- Share IAM role template + minimal permissions after final call.
- Prepare a short demo script for canary day (show rolling out a small model variant, metrics dashboard).
- Add step in onboarding checklist to verify Splunk mapping keys (request sample log).

Relevant links for quick reference:
- Onboarding Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Elm+Park+Bank+Onboarding
- Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-3241
- Slack channel: #se-elmpark (invite EPB infra once ok)

Next sync: 2024-11-12 11:00am ET (technical deep-dive)

Random scratch notes:
- try to get SAML metadata XML before 11/13 so Samira can test.
- ask EPB about allowed third-party libs in runtime (policy question)
- confirm if they want model weights stored in their S3 or Redwood-managed storage (affects encryption + egress)

End of scratchpad for now. Keep this doc as the living list; will prune once things move to Confluence/PRs.

---
Short changelog: 2024-11-08 initial notes; 2024-11-09 added canary plan; 2024-11-12 updated network TODO owner; 2024-11-15 added legal follow-up (prompt logging).
